content: Jesús tu̱choda jvaavyenchiy
“Jarichumuvichi̱ nusu̱yada ji̱ta rañi̱cha nta nu̱tyu rorijya̱mi̱, jiryatiy sani ju̱u̱ryi̱ sa̱tidye va̱ta nudiy jvaavyeñe̱cho̱.
Su̱dutya̱danumatiy jvaavyejsa̱ra nuriryara sa̱murichenu tarundaqui jvaayada murichirya riy, su̱pa̱jada ji̱ta yindimyu variryi, jiryatiy ni̱nsijyu̱u̱ni̱ra.
Sama̱seda ji̱ta ju̱na̱ntyi mumuri̱ jóramusiy, sadiyada ji̱ta ruuva tavay, mitya ranivye pudásamu, su̱teda variy ruuva: ‘Jirya̱numa jiya jvaavye ni̱nsijyu̱u̱ni̱mu, ra̱murichenu vase variy jirye.’
Riya̱da ji̱ta variy. Ju̱na̱ntyi sama̱seda ji̱ta nu̱ñi mumuri̱ jóramusiy, sivaayada daryadantyi.

Taraqui jóradenumatiy su̱tyeda ruuvaamyu̱yadaju̱, sama̱seda rorijya̱mi̱ pudásamuntiy, sasaryeda riy tavay ranivyentyi, su̱teda ji̱ta variy ruuva: ‘¿Ta̱raju̱ jiryeryaniy pituvye ju̱daca̱ jiyu, ta̱raju̱?’
Ru̱mutya̱jadani̱: ‘Ne ti̱ jvaatyaniryu̱y daryaju̱ nu̱dye.’ Su̱teda ji̱ta variy ruuva: ‘Jiryejerye ra̱jiya jvaavye ni̱nsijyu̱u̱ni̱mu.’
Jidyenumatiy ravicha̱da, su̱teda rorijya̱mi̱ siva yivaatyani̱: ‘Ya̱numa naturyi jvaavye, ya̱murichenu varintyiryi. Ya̱jo̱ta murichedoda tamityavamyusiy, munatyavacha̱ra̱ju̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱.’
Ruuto̱jadanumatiy tamityavay, ru̱mutya̱jada nu̱ñi ti̱quimusirya tarundaqui jvaayada murichirya, miryanura.
Ru̱to̱jadanumatiy munatyavay, rijechipiya̱jada: ‘Nu̱ña̱jmutya̱ dyetya ja̱mura ruumusiy.’ Ru̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta ti̱ta̱ju̱ nu̱ñi tarundaqui jvaayada murichirya nu̱ñi ti̱quimusiy.
Ru̱mutya̱jadanumatirya, ricyucuye̱yada ji̱ta rorijya̱mi̱nijyu̱.
Riñiquejada ji̱ta: ‘Jivye tamityavay, rañi jvaayasiy taraqui jóradera, jiiñi bay vatajuu nu̱dyisa̱ riy, jiryatiy nu̱jechi̱desiy ju̱daca̱ jvaayada vidyaquisumajareyu.’
Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱tani̱ ti̱qui rityenu: ‘Ne rapyaranu ji, Jaamyicyu. ¿Neviy vuryi̱dutyajay tarundaqui jvaayada murichirya dajyu̱ú̱?
Ya̱jirirya jiyaru̱rya, ye̱jiya varintyi. Ramyurichenuru̱ryi tamityavay daryatiy ramyurichenuntiy ji.
¿Samirya dyetya ra̱jvaay racyuriquitya daryatiy rivaaryu̱y? ¿Jamiryamuviy yinu̱y rana̱cho̱ jiryatiy rivaay samirya mitya day?’

Ramuni̱, rityi vichasara tamityavay, rirye̱chasara ji̱ta munatyavay, daryadantyi, rityi vichasara ji̱ta munatyavay, rirye̱chasara tamityavay varintyi. Ti̱quitya daryaju̱ riñi̱cha natuchavay, rajuutya ji̱ta jaryetasavadye.”
Jesús tu̱choda ju̱na̱y jibetyedajiju̱ntiy

Saya̱danumatiy Jesús Jerusarí̱ na̱cho̱ju̱, sa̱ra̱cheda ji̱ta riy vinu yisa̱ datyavavyedabay vu̱yaju̱y, danu̱ju̱y rinchaju̱, satu̱chutityiyada ruuva: “Vurya̱sumiñuma ji̱ta Jerusarí̱muju̱. Nijya̱mi̱denu rirya̱sa̱chara caserdótevyeda nutyityu̱mimyuju̱, Ju̱denu niquejada datyanuvamyu jarye, rirya̱bay ji̱ta diiyasi̱ju̱ variñi̱.
Jadchiy ji̱ta rirya̱sa̱y variy ma̱myimyuni̱, rirya̱tidye jarupantani̱, rirya̱tidye musiye̱ varintyiñi̱, rirya̱jvay variy crusitya̱sa ti̱ta̱ju̱ni̱; jadchiy ji̱ta mumurundamimyusiy sa̱cha mi̱sanichi̱.”
Sebedévubay vaturu̱be jachiñu̱yada simu Jesús jidyenuju̱be jiyadaju̱
Jadchiy ji̱ta, nanutuudiyada ji̱ta Sebedévubay vaturu̱be nanudenuju̱betyani̱ Jesús, nana̱dasidyodanumatiy satuunuyu, nanujachiñu̱yada tara variy siva.

Ni̱ni̱ ji̱ta jteda nadiva: “¿Ta̱rana̱ sa̱nuva̱ta, ta̱ra?” Nani̱teda variy siva: “Ya̱jtay nana̱ma̱sa radyenuju̱y jityuunu, yinsu̱yadamu, ti̱qui ra̱cha yintyityudamyuju̱, nu̱ntiy ra̱cha jimyidámyuju̱ntidye.”

Su̱mutya̱jada ji̱ta Jesús variy: “Ne sa̱dadatya ta̱na̱ sa̱ni va̱ta. ¿Sa̱na̱vidye jachi̱niy rajuura jantya̱daju̱ dayu, nu̱tyi ratyi ra̱paru̱tyajaya̱sara darya ray?” Nani̱mutya̱jada ji̱tani̱: “¡Neviy na̱ña̱ju̱ú̱!”

Su̱teda Jesús variy nadiva: “Daryaday sa̱na̱paru̱tyajaya̱ntidyeyu, nu̱tyu ratyi ra̱paru̱tyajaya̱ntidyerye. Tama̱ vana̱y ntate rabe rayntyityudamyuju̱ ma̱sa̱daju̱ ji, tama̱, dantyamu̱y ne ramyidámyuju̱. Rijyu̱ ji̱ta ra̱chasara daryatiy su̱dutyama̱ Rajye̱rya.”
Rityuva̱chodanumatiy vu̱yaju̱y nanutevarya darya niquejada, riñique̱yada ji̱ta nadisa̱ mityijyi taryi̱ju̱y.

Jesús ji̱ta natuyada variy yimuju̱ riy, saniquejada variy: “Jiryedyetyanuma jiryatiy ma̱y nutyityu̱ rañi jpa̱ jaryiryi jiryenu ma̱myi. Ni̱tiy vichasara jaryi ma̱myi nutyityu̱ nubesi̱, ni̱ni̱ nusu̱y jaryiryi jityevay.
Jiryequebyimu ji̱tamu̱y ne raryicha daryá. Ni̱tiy ra̱charu̱y jaryiñu̱ jiryimusiy, sa̱ma̱ jvaay nu̱tyu jiryemyuchechiy.

Ni̱tiy ra̱charu̱y munatyi̱ jiryimusiy, sa̱ma̱ jvaay nu̱tyu jiryecyumude, daryatiy su̱deda Nijya̱mi̱denu, ne sa̱tidye jvaatyaniy jiyadaju̱ riy tavay, su̱deda ji̱ta sa̱tidye jmu̱tyasara riy tavay, sa̱tidye sa̱charara yinu̱yada nijya̱nvajyuu jantyutya̱daju̱ varintyi.”
Jesús mi̱sadeda nada ni̱sipyuryijyu̱be
Richipyatedanumatiy Jesúsveda Jericómusiy, richiityari̱jada nijya̱nvajyuubañi̱ Jesús.
Mityamusiy, nanutuva̱chodanumatiy danu̱ju̱y ni̱sipyuryijyu̱be nú̱tuva̱rya ma̱sanu̱y: “Saramiryi̱ Jesús,” nanuniquejasubeda ji̱ta: “¡Ya̱jantyutya na̱y, Davyíbe jasi̱!”
Nijya̱nvay ji̱ta nique̱tya̱da nada: “¡Sa̱na̱ndasa!” Nanuniquejasubeda ji̱ta jaryivya̱ju̱ variy: “¡Nutyityu̱, ya̱jantyutya na̱y, Davyíbe jasi̱!”
Saradedanumatiy Jesús, sanatuyada variy nada: “¿Nu̱tyura sa̱dava̱ta ra̱chaniyu, nu̱tyura?”
Nani̱teda ji̱ta siva: “¡Nutyityu̱, ya̱muttara na̱ñi̱siquiii!”
Sa̱ntyutya̱damu jije̱tyo̱jada Jesús nanuni̱simyu, nani̱nu̱yasubeda varicha̱ra̱ju̱, nanusiityari̱jada ji̱ta variñi̱.
